## **Pricing and paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Pricing and paywall.**
      4 recent review(s) mention pricing and paywall.
      Review window: Jul 28, 2026 - Aug 3, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Nancy Richey_, Jul 31, 2026, 1/5: "I cannot cancel this app in the trial period. The directions don't line up with the experience. If you are not positive you want this app, do NOT start the trial period."
            2. _Caitlin Simmons_, Jul 28, 2026, 1/5: "I was randomly logged out of this app several days ago and can't log back in. I've attempted to reset my password, but no password reset email arrives in my inbox. I emailed support but haven't heard back. I pay for a premium subscription to this app and I am about to cancel since I can't access it."
            3. _A Google user_, Aug 2, 2026, 2/5: "overall I actually use the app daily and it can be useful but even with premium there is one thing that is SOSO annoying. in terms of setting up recurring meals that you can reuse, their interface for Android or through the web browser does NOT allow for easy editing. that may not sound like much youre truly trying to calorie count and make it simple, this is SO annoying. Sadly, it seems like a complicated thing to fix or they would have already... unfortunately it really needs to be fixed. pls!"
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Ads pressure** {#theme-ads}

<!--ir-theme:ads-->
   **Ads pressure.**
      2 recent review(s) mention ads pressure.
      Review window: Aug 2, 2026 - Aug 2, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users are noticing ad pressure. This can signal monetization friction and an opening for a cleaner competitor.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Johan Laursen_, Aug 2, 2026, 1/5: "I pay for premium to not have ads and get extra features. Instead this app goes out of its way to annoy with notifications and pop ups about streaks like the most annoying ads possible. Cannot recommend until the developers learn basic common sense and atleast provide the option to remove usage streaks."
            2. _Kevin Haaboja_, Aug 2, 2026, 1/5: "1 star just to get your attention. Creating meals is still broken. When I add foods to a meal, it randomly empties itself. Sometimes right away, sometimes later. This bug has been coming and going for over a year. Are you ever going to fix it? Also the ads are annoying. They pop up after the screen loads and push the content down, which causes accidentally miss the buttons or whatever."
<!--/ir-theme-->
